template.name: seqdex/round-order

params.label: The asset the order sells, which the coin holds
params.name: ASSET_A

params.label: The asset a fill pays in
params.name: ASSET_B

params.label: Limit: the order accepts no less than LIMIT_NUM atoms of ASSET_B for every LIMIT_DEN atoms of ASSET_A
params.name: LIMIT_NUM

params.label: Limit denominator: LIMIT_NUM atoms of ASSET_B for every LIMIT_DEN atoms of ASSET_A
params.name: LIMIT_DEN

params.label: Least a fill takes, and least a remainder holds, in ASSET_A
params.name: MIN_LOT

params.label: The maker's payout script, which every fill pays
params.name: MAKER

params.label: From this lock time the refund key may take the coin back: below 500,000,000 a block height, else a Unix time compared with the median time past
params.name: EXPIRY

params.label: The key that takes the coin back after EXPIRY
params.name: REFUND_KEY

params.label: The clearer: only a round this key signs fills the order
params.name: CLEARER

paths.effect: Fills the order in part in a round: the round's last output publishes its one price, N of QUOTE per D of BASE, for the order's two assets; output 2k pays MAKER exactly ceil(fill x rate) of ASSET_B at that price, which is at least the limit, and output 2k+1 holds the remainder, at least MIN_LOT, at this same script. CLEARER signs the round transaction. This coin is input k. PATH is Left((true, (FLIP, (N, D)))).
paths.name: fill

paths.effect: Fills the whole order in a round, as fill with no remainder; output 2k+1 is the round's. PATH is Left((false, (FLIP, (N, D)))).
paths.name: fill_whole

paths.effect: Once the transaction's lock time reaches EXPIRY, the refund key takes the coin, signing the whole transaction. PATH is Right(()).
paths.name: refund

template.summary: A SeqDEX round order: filled, in part or in whole, only in a clearing round its clearer signs, at the one price the round publishes in its last output and never below its limit; after expiry the refund key takes it back.

fill_whole.transaction: a round of four orders, the clearer's two gap coins and a fee coin; twelve outputs, the clearing output last

fill_whole_flip.transaction: the same round, a bid filled whole

fill_flip.transaction: the same round, a bid filled in part

refund.transaction: the remainder and a fee coin; the refund, the fee change and the fee
